tool_notes: Pickaxe: tap a relic to break it.
Dynamite: tap a relic to blast around it.
Sunburst: tap a piece to hit all pieces of that kind.

notes: A life returns every 30 minutes, up to five.
Discovery Stars unlock stock and land. First clears only; never spent.
Placed buildings earn decoration points for the next quest.
